newsitem.title: FRANCE: France calls Israeli housing "obstacle to peace".
newsitem.headline: France calls Israeli housing "obstacle to peace".

text.p: French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette on Tuesday called Israel's construction of a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem "an obstacle to peace" and warned against a resurgence of violence in the region.

"This decision... is an obstacle to peace," de Charette told reporters. "I hope that violence will not start again in this part of the Middle East and I can only suggest to both sides to do all they can to avoid it."

As he spoke, Israeli bulldozers arriving in a heavily guarded convoy broke ground for the 6,500 housing units at Jabal Abu Ghneim, a pine-covered hilltop called Har Homa by Israel, despite worldwide criticism and fears of Palestinian violence.

"France feels that the decision taken by the Israeli government goes against the spirit and the letter of the Oslo accords, as well as other accords between Israelis and Palestinians," de Charette said during a press luncheon.
